name: Parks
tagline: Plans road trips across the US National Parks, down to printable day sheets.
description: Parks covers all 63 US National Parks: pick parks, optimise multi-park road trips, build day-by-day plans and printable day sheets, and track the parks you've visited on a passport-style map with where-next trip ideas. Budget/pass guide, tours and excursions (authorised operators first), optional live NPS data, timed entry, lodging, camping, wildlife, trails, and seasons via nps.gov and Recreation.gov. One question at a time, ranked options, no invented fees, availability, or animal guarantees.
author: bradshannon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
